hero.h1: Ourika Valley & Atlas Mountains Day Trip
hero.lead: Marrakech → Argan Co-op → Berber Village → Setti Fatma Waterfalls → Marrakech

overview.h2: The easiest mountain escape from Marrakech
paras: The easiest budget day trip from Marrakech: a short hop into the High Atlas foothills for mountain air, Berber villages, and a waterfall hike, all in about 7 hours round trip including stops.

Stops include a women's argan oil cooperative, a scenic drive through terraced Berber villages along the Ourika river, and a guided walk toward the Setti Fatma waterfalls, with free time for lunch by the river.
chips: 🚗 ≈130 km round trip · about 3.5 hrs driving

good.h2: A gentle first taste of the Atlas
paras: The waterfall hike involves some uneven, rocky paths — trainers or light hiking shoes are recommended. A guided option all the way to the falls is available for a small local fee.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure time, final price, and pickup details by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.q: How difficult is the waterfall walk?
items.a: Easy to moderate — a well-trodden path with some rocky, uneven sections. Most fitness levels can manage it at a relaxed pace.
No, but there are riverside cafés near Setti Fatma serving tagines and grilled dishes, generally €5–10 per person.

items.q: Can I combine this with the Agafay Desert trip?
items.a: Yes — many travelers do Ourika Valley one day and Agafay Desert the next, since both depart from Marrakech.
